policy: Every entry is code that exists only to read or convert names Stave no longer uses, or to replay a rename on another branch. `bun run check:temporary-migrations` fails once package.json reaches removeInVersion; delete the marked blocks, the listed tests and the entry before that release. See AGENTS.md, Temporary Migrations.

migrations.description: Moves app_state values saved under routine_state_v1 and routine_provider_timeout_ms_v1 to the automation keys, renaming routines/routineId to automations/automationId.
Renames the task_heartbeats and task_heartbeat_occurrences tables, the heartbeat_id column and their indexes to the wake-up names.
Rewrites ledger rows written with the child-task run kind, child-task-turn step kind and child-task bookkeeping codes to the delegated-task names. Run ids keep their child-task prefix on purpose.
Renames the tracker_tasks_cache and tracker_task_kickoffs tables and their indexes to the tracker issue names.
Moves the trackerTasks setting, the navigation.tasks shortcut override, legacy command palette recents and the stave.tracker-tasks.* local view keys to the Issues names.

Renames the projectMappings key of saved Jira and Crane connector settings to repositoryMappings, so the connectors keep their site, URL, enabled flag and mappings after the projects->repositories rename.

Maps the persisted zustand keys recentProjects, projectPath and projectName, and the projectPath, projectName and projectBasePrompt fields of each registered-repository entry (in that snapshot and in SQLite's project_registry), to the repository names, so the registered-repository list and current selection survive the projects->repositories rename.
Maps a saved right-rail layout that names the old collaboration panel id to the Team panel that replaced it, so the panel a user left open survives the rename.

Maps a saved right-rail layout that names the retired Turn Activity, Task Results, Mission, Flow or Team panel ids to the Task panel and the tab that replaced each, so the panel a user left open survives the merge.
Renames the path-scoped project_memories and project_memory_settings tables to repository_memories and repository_memory_settings so the projects feature can create its own project_memories table.

Replays the vocabulary renames (routine to automation, task heartbeat to wake-up, child task to delegated task, tracker task to tracker issue, project to repository, and later renames) on branches that started before they landed.
